method: Heat the oven to 200C fan. Tip the Cod, sweetcorn and Caribbean Curry into a large roasting tin with oil and seasoning and toss.
Roast for 30-35 minutes, turning once, until the cod is cooked through and everything is golden at the edges.
Serve straight from the tin with potatoes.
